properties.input: Share details of Zip PO PO4340
properties.expected_output: [LIVE DATA] All values here are dynamic and can change at any time (amounts, billed/unbilled, statuses, approvers and assignees, current step, due dates, counts, linked records, lists). Grade whether the right kind of information is given for the record asked about, not whether it matches the snapshot values. Must include: PO number, linked request 4078, total and billed amounts, billing status, each amount with a currency. Nice to include: unbilled amount, linked invoices, location. Currency: this is a Zip PO, and Zip records its location as 'Bangalore-Bagmane Solarium City (USD)', so the agent may show the amounts in the currency Zip reports (USD) or in the PO's NetSuite currency (INR / ₹); both are acceptable. Must: use one currency consistently for all amounts on this PO. Must not: mix currencies for the same PO or show a bare number with no currency. Snapshot values (may differ now): 3 Nov 2026 – total 8,717,249.97; billed 2,462,499.99; Partially billed; NetSuite currency INR.
